title: OpenAI extends its Daybreak cyber-defence program to Ukraine
friendlyTitle: Ukraine will use OpenAI tools to help protect essential services
summary: OpenAI will give Ukrainian government teams access to Daybreak tools for finding software vulnerabilities, investigating suspicious activity and testing fixes for civilian infrastructure. The company says similar access has helped European agencies identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
friendlySummary: OpenAI is giving Ukrainian cyber teams tools to find software weaknesses and test repairs for systems used by hospitals, energy providers and phone networks.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete example of advanced models being deployed as supervised tools for defensive security work. The results will matter beyond government because hospitals, utilities and telecommunications providers face many of the same legacy-software risks.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI may help defenders find problems faster, but trained people still need to approve and test every repair. Lessons from this work could help other essential services too.
